items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Joe and I -- Teddy and Gus. Gus played trombone and was a very good arranger.

ctx.x: Joe and I -- Teddy and Gus. Gus played trombone and was a very good arranger. He was a good trombone player too. He was an excellent arranger.
And then after that I joined Zack Way (PHONETIC).
